exposure: Delivery mode (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 1777 women giving birth in two district hospitals and five health centers in Lao PDR
finding: The study found a very high rate of antibiotic prescription in connection to childbirth, exceeding WHO guidelines, with all women receiving antibiotics regardless of delivery mode, highlighting the need for interventions to promote appropriate antibiotic use.
mod_finding: 85.5% of women who underwent a caesarean section received antibiotic treatment for 5 days, while women who had a vaginal delivery usually had antibiotic treatment for one day or less.
